context.description: Extensible helm-values context block passed direct to template/kluctl

expose.description: Declarative Exposure Rules: keys must strictly match keys in 'ports'

k0rdent.description: Escape hatch for Mirantis K0rdent service configurations

kustomize.description: Dynamic kustomize context mappings matching full upstream schemas

tags.description: Logical tags for stack/feature grouping and cascading (k8s labels & Kluctl tags)

ConfigMapArgs.description: ConfigMapArgs contains the metadata of how to generate a configmap

envs.description: A list of file paths. The contents of each file should be one key=value pair per line

files.description: A list of file sources to use in creating a list of key, value pairs

literals.description:
A list of literal pair sources. Each literal source should be a key and
literal value, e.g. `key=value`

name.description: Name - actually the partial name - of the generated resource

FieldSelector.description: Contains the fieldPath to an object field

GeneratorOptions.description: GeneratorOptions modify behavior of all ConfigMap and Secret generators

annotations.description: Annotations to add to all generated resources

disableNameSuffixHash.description:
DisableNameSuffixHash if true disables the default behavior of adding a
suffix to the names of generated resources that is a hash of the resource
contents

immutable.description: Immutable if true add to all generated resources

labels.description: Labels to add to all generated resources

Inventory.description:
Inventory appends an object that contains the record of all other objects,
which can be used in apply, prune and delete

bases.description:
DEPRECATED. Bases are relative paths or git repository URLs specifying a
directory containing a kustomization.yaml file.

buildMetadata.description: BuildMetadata is a list of strings used to toggle different build options

commonAnnotations.description: CommonAnnotations to add to all objects

commonLabels.description: CommonLabels to add to all objects and selectors

components.description:
Components are relative paths or git repository URLs specifying a directory
containing a kustomization.yaml file of Kind Component.

configMapGenerator.description:
ConfigMapGenerator is a list of configmaps to generate from local data (one
configMap per list item)

configurations.description: Configurations is a list of transformer configuration files

crds.description:
Crds specifies relative paths to Custom Resource Definition files. This
allows custom resources to be recognized as operands, making it possible to
add them to the Resources list. CRDs themselves are not modified.

generators.description: Generators is a list of files containing custom generators

helmCharts.description: HelmCharts is a list of helm chart configuration instances

helmGlobals.description: HelmGlobals contains helm configuration that isn't chart specific

chartHome.description:
ChartHome is a file path, relative to the kustomization root, to a directory
containing a subdirectory for each chart to be included in the kustomization

configHome.description:
ConfigHome defines a value that kustomize should pass to helm via the
HELM_CONFIG_HOME environment variable

images.description:
Images is a list of (image name, new name, new tag or digest) for changing
image names, tags or digests. This can also be achieved with a patch, but
this operator is simpler to specify.

labels.description: Labels to add to all objects but not selectors

namePrefix.description:
NamePrefix will prefix the names of all resources mentioned in the
kustomization file including generated configmaps and secrets

nameSuffix.description:
NameSuffix will suffix the names of all resources mentioned in the
kustomization file including generated configmaps and secrets

namespace.description: Namespace to add to all objects

openapi.description: OpenAPI contains information about what kubernetes schema to use

patches.description: Apply a patch to multiple resources

patchesJson6902.description: JSONPatches is a list of JSONPatch for applying JSON patch. See http://jsonpatch.com

patchesStrategicMerge.description:
PatchesStrategicMerge specifies the relative path to a file containing a
strategic merge patch. URLs and globs are not supported

replacements.description: Substitute field(s) in N target(s) with a field from a source

replicas.description:
Replicas is a list of (resource name, count) for changing number of replicas
for a resources. It will match any group and kind that has a matching name
and that is one of: Deployment, ReplicationController, Replicaset,
Statefulset.

resources.description:
Resources specifies relative paths to files holding YAML representations of
kubernetes API objects. URLs and globs not supported.

secretGenerator.description: SecretGenerator is a list of secrets to generate from local data (one secret per list item)

sortOptions.description: sortOptions is used to sort the resources kustomize outputs

transformers.description: Transformers is a list of files containing transformers

validators.description: Validators is a list of files containing validators

vars.description:
Allows things modified by kustomize to be injected into a container
specification. A var is a name (e.g. FOO) associated with a field in a
specific resource instance. The field must contain a value of type string,
and defaults to the name field of the instance

fields.description:
FieldSpec completely specifies a kustomizable field in a k8s API object. It
helps define the operands of transformations

includeSelectors.description: IncludeSelectors indicates should transformer include the fieldSpecs for selectors

includeTemplates.description: IncludeTemplates indicates should transformer include the template labels

pairs.description: Pairs contains the key-value pairs for labels to add

path.description: relative file path for a json patch file inside a kustomization

target.description:
Refers to a Kubernetes object that the json patch will be applied to. It must
refer to a Kubernetes resource under the purview of this kustomization

Refers to a Kubernetes object that the json patch will be applied to. It must
refer to a Kubernetes resource under the purview of this kustomization

Refers to a Kubernetes object that the patch will be applied to. It must
refer to a Kubernetes resource under the purview of this kustomization

Refers to a Kubernetes object that the patch will be applied to. It must
refer to a Kubernetes resource under the purview of this kustomization

targets.description: The N fields to write the value to
The N fields to write the value to

fieldPath.description: The structured path to the source value

fieldPaths.description: The structured path(s) to the target nodes

SecretArgs.description: SecretArgs contains the metadata of how to generate a secret

name.description: Name - actually the partial name - of the generated resource

Selector.description:
Selector specifies a set of resources.
Any resource that matches intersection of all conditions is included in this set.

annotationSelector.description:
AnnotationSelector is a string that follows the label selection expression
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#api

labelSelector.description:
LabelSelector is a string that follows the label selection expression
https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/#api

Var.description: Represents a variable whose value will be sourced from a field in a Kubernetes object.

fieldref.description:
Refers to the field of the object referred to by objref whose value will be
extracted for use in replacing $(FOO)

name.description:
Value of identifier name e.g. FOO used in container args, annotations,
Appears in pod template as $(FOO)

objref.description: Refers to a Kubernetes resource under the purview of this kustomization

apps.description: Grouped application specifications by category/group (e.g., example, games, infra, etc.)
